_comment: Copy this to devices.json and fill in as you add hardware. Everything here is OPTIONAL — the assistant runs fine with an empty config and you add devices later. Get Tuya deviceId/localKey with:  python -m tinytuya wizard
_devices_comment: Named devices on your LAN for 'control_device' — say e.g. 'turn on the fan node' or 'wake my desktop'. Types: wol (wake a PC by MAC), http (call a URL, e.g. an ESP32 relay with /on and /off endpoints), light/plug (Tuya), mqtt (a custom ESP node), ping (status only).
_computers_comment: Other laptops/PCs running agent/hermes_agent.py, for 'open X on the other laptop'. Get each one's URL from what the agent prints when it starts. Token must match this brain's HERMES_TOKEN.
